metaTitle: Audio Speed & Pitch Changer + Waveform (Free) | ReelFlow Toolkit
description: Speed up or slow down audio, shift the pitch and save a new WAV, plus a waveform PNG. Runs entirely in your browser.
ogTitle: Audio Speed & Pitch - Playback and Waveform
ogDescription: Change audio speed or pitch on your device and export a WAV or a waveform image.
ldDescription: Adjust audio playback speed and pitch in the browser, export the result as WAV and save a waveform image.
lede: Load an audio or video file, change the speed or shift the pitch, and export a new WAV. The same page also saves a waveform image for thumbnails and show notes.

faq.q: Does changing speed change the pitch?
faq.a: Yes - this works like a tape: faster playback raises the pitch and shortens the file. The pitch slider applies the same effect on top. There is no time-stretch, so every change alters the length.

faq.q: What is the waveform image for?
faq.a: It draws the loudness over time as a clean PNG you can use in a video thumbnail, podcast cover or show notes.
Audio the browser can decode (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG) plus the audio track of MP4, MOV and WebM videos.
